text:
Peyton Krebs will always be known as part of the Jack Eichel trade, but in Buffalo he's become a useful, playmaking middle-six centre. He has nine points in 17 games, eight of them assists, including three in Anaheim, and talked on Audacy this week about his chemistry with Tage Thompson. He finally scored his first of the season against Ottawa, and the Sabres titled his postgame video after that loss: "These Are The Games You Need To Win To Make The Playoffs".

The points are running a little hot. Buffalo's shooters have scored 4.3 more goals than expected with him on the ice, and the line has been slightly outchanced (48% of the expected goals at five on five, the quality of chances). He also barely shoots, 10 shots all season. Evolving-Hockey had him at 1.5 wins above replacement last season but warned that his results ran well ahead of his chances, so some of that came from hot shooting. A pass-first centre who skates well is valuable. A pass-first centre whose passes stop going in will need to shoot more.
